# Prabhat's Score SMP

Prabhat's Score SMP is a competitive survival plugin that adds a score-based challenge system to your Minecraft server.

Players must survive, complete difficult tasks, and avoid dying to keep their score alive.

If your score reaches zero, you are temporarily banned from the server.

This plugin is designed for hardcore SMP servers and competitive communities.

--------------------------------

## Core Features

• Every player starts with 30 Score  
• Score is visible below the player's nametag  
• Death removes score points  
• Players get random difficult tasks  
• Completing tasks rewards score  
• If score reaches 0 → player banned for 30 days  
• If a task is not completed in time → player banned for 20 days  

--------------------------------

## Task System

Players receive random challenging tasks such as:

• Build 30 houses in spawn  
• Kill multiple players in PvP  
• Craft Netherite armor sets  
• Explore different biomes  

Tasks are automatically verified by the plugin to prevent cheating.

--------------------------------

## Anti-Cheat System

The plugin prevents common exploits:

• Killing the same player repeatedly does not count  
• Block placement spam is ignored  
• Task completion cannot be triggered with commands  
• Progress is automatically tracked  

--------------------------------

## Commands

/score  
Shows your current score.

/scoretop  
Shows the server leaderboard.

/task  
Receive your current task.

/task progress  
View task progress.

--------------------------------

## Admin Commands

/score set <player> <amount>  
/score add <player> <amount>  
/score remove <player> <amount>  
/task reset <player>  
/scoresmp reload  

Permission:
scoresmp.admin

--------------------------------

## Configuration

All values can be edited in the config files:

• starting score  
• death score loss  
• task rewards  
• task time limits  
• ban durations  
• messages  

Tasks can be fully customized inside tasks.yml.

--------------------------------

## Compatibility

Minecraft Version: 1.21+  
Server Software: Paper / Spigot

--------------------------------
